description: SLOs, alerts, and error budgets for the deny-by-default multi-tenant task service. Tenant isolation is enforced by core.mjs owned() chokepoint; these SLOs keep the service available, fast, and observable. No secret values are stored here.

slos.name: api-availability
slos.description: Fraction of HTTP requests that do NOT return a 5xx. 401/403 deny-by-default responses are correct behavior and are excluded from the error SLI.

slos.name: api-latency-p99
slos.description: Fraction of requests served under the p99 latency target of 300ms.

slos.name: ingest-saturation
slos.description: Fraction of time the task ingest queue stays under 80% of capacity. Leading indicator for latency/error cascades.
